notes.title: First update + Important info
notes.content:
Hi,
I updated the game for the first time. I fixed some problems players were complaining about, such as:
- Not being able to open the Menu while looking at doors / items
- Minor bugs

Some people think each of two available characters has the same levels. That's wrong, each character features different levels with unique elements. If you finished the game with one character, you actually finished 50% of the entire game.

I would be really happy if some of you could leave a review. 
Have fun. :)
